title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
slides: Can Airbnb's AI travel agent replace your trip planning?
The AI agent launches in the first half of 2027
It reportedly uses your booking history to design itineraries
Your saved preferences may shape every future recommendation
Start curating your Airbnb profile like a travel brief
thread_text:
1. Your next trip planned by AI?

Airbnb is building an AI travel agent that reportedly uses your booking history to design itineraries. It launches in the first half of 2027.

2. Your booking history is the blueprint

The agent reportedly pulls from your past stays to suggest future trips. That means every reservation becomes training data for your next itinerary.

3. Saved preferences shape everything

Your saved filters and wishlists may drive every recommendation the AI makes. The more you save, the more the agent mirrors your past choices.

4. The real test: your profile

If the AI relies on your history, a thin profile means generic suggestions. The quality of your trip planning depends on how much you've curated.

5. Start your travel brief now

Open your Airbnb profile and update your saved preferences and wishlists. Treat it like a brief for the AI agent that's coming in 2027.
